description: This file defines the PrismaIntegrationAttributeSyncRepository class, implementing methods for managing integration attribute sync entities in a database using Prisma ORM. It includes methods for fetching, creating, updating, and deleting sync records, as well as retrieving related mappings and attribute IDs.

classes.name: PrismaIntegrationAttributeSyncRepository
classes.description: Repository class for managing integration attribute sync entities using Prisma ORM.

methods.name: getByOrganizationId
methods.description: Fetches all integration attribute sync records for a specific organization.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a specific integration attribute sync record by its ID.

methods.name: getSyncFieldMappings
methods.description: Gets the field mappings associated with a specific sync record.

methods.name: getMappedAttributeIdsByOrganization
methods.description: Retrieves attribute IDs mapped for an organization, optionally excluding a specific sync ID.

methods.name: getAttributeIdsByOrganization
methods.description: Gets attribute IDs for an organization filtered by a list of attribute IDs.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new integration attribute sync record with associated rule and field mappings.

methods.name: updateTransactionWithRuleAndMappings
methods.description: Performs a transactional update of sync record, rule, and field mappings.

methods.name: deleteById
methods.description: Deletes a sync record by its ID.

methods.name: getAllByCredentialId
methods.description: Fetches all sync records associated with a specific credential ID.
